title: MSA redline touchpoint — tight window / mini-sprint
text:
MSA redline touchpoint — tight window / mini-sprint

["From: Elaine Park <elaine@clearharbor.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearharbor.com
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA redline touchpoint — can we do a short sprint this week?

Hi Mateo,

We're close on the MSA but procurement has a few last-minute redlines we need to walk through. Would Redwood be available for a short 30–40 minute redline sprint this week so we can agree on the last items and get procurement sign-off?

Key constraints on our side: the internal legal lead is only available in the mornings PT, and procurement has a checkpoint meeting Friday afternoon that we'd like to avoid missing. Our suggested goals: confirm the 3 change items in Section 2, align data retention language, and agree on the signature timeline.

Attached: ClearHarbor_MSA_redlines_v3.docx (redline) — it's small.

Can you propose 3 windows (30–40m) that work for Redwood? If you want, include a brief pre-read and we'll do a focused call.

Thanks —
Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Procurement, ClearHarbor
elaine@clearharbor.com
+1 (415) 555-0149

", "From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@clearharbor.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redline touchpoint — can we do a short sprint this week?

Hi Elaine — thanks for sending the doc. We can do a short sprint and keep it laser-focused. Proposed 30-minute windows (PT):

- Tue 3/30 09:00–09:30 PT
- Tue 3/30 11:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 3/31 08:30–09:00 PT

Attendees from our side: me (legal program lead), Laura Bennett (implementation / onboarding lead), and Karthik Iyer (procurement liaison) — we can keep technical folks on standby if a clause requires model/runtime detail.

Plan for the call: 1) 5-min framing & priority list, 2) focused walk of the three Section 2 items (document shared), 3) agreement on retention & post-signature timeline. We'll prepare a 1-page pre-read and send it before the meeting.

Laura / Karthik — do any of these windows conflict with other commitments? If not, I'll pencil Tue 3/30 11:00–11:30 PT and hold until Elaine confirms.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com | +1 (617) 555-0222

", "From: Elaine Park <elaine@clearharbor.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearharbor.com
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redline touchpoint — can we do a short sprint this week?

Thanks Mateo — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Quick update from my side: procurement just flagged a brief freeze on calendar changes this afternoon while they finalize an internal roster (apologies — poor timing). That means our earliest confirmed availability is Tue 3/30 after 10:30 PT. 11:00 PT works for us if it still works for Redwood.

If we land 11:00–11:30 PT Tuesday, procurement will try to have their redline lead on the line (probable but not guaranteed). Either way we should be able to resolve the Section 2 language and retention items; signature timeline depends on their internal approval post-call.

Also attaching a short procurement checklist — it's a convenience doc, not required: redwood-preflight-questions.pdf

Elaine

", "From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@clearharbor.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redline touchpoint — can we do a short sprint this week?

All — 11:00–11:30 PT Tue 3/30 is good on our side, thanks for the quick coordination.

I'll draft and circulate a 1-page pre-read that calls out the three Section 2 items and the proposed retention language bullet-by-bullet. Mateo will own the call; Karthik, would you add any procurement constraints we should be aware of ahead of time?

We'll send the calendar invite with the redline doc and the pre-read attached. If procurement confirms their lead, please copy them into the invite so we have visibility.

See you Tuesday —
Laura Bennett
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
